name: Ram Niwash Pandey
title: Sr. Frontend Developer
profile: Frontend Developer with {experience} of experience building scalable, high-performance SaaS applications using React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML, and CSS, along with modern UI frameworks like Material UI and Tailwind CSS. Currently working on BigFix, delivering user-centric features with a focus on performance optimization, accessibility (WCAG), reusable component architecture, REST API integration, and AI-driven development using ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot.

Experienced in developing data-intensive interfaces, optimizing rendering and state management for large-scale applications, and contributing to system design in product-driven environments. Proven ability to take end-to-end ownership of features, from requirement analysis to production deployment, ensuring reliable and maintainable solutions. Familiar with Node.js and Express.js for backend integration, with an emphasis on writing clean, production-ready code and following best engineering practices.

bullets: Developed scalable and enterprise-grade frontend features for BigFix(enterprise SaaS endpoint management platform) using React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), Material UI

Owned end-to-end delivery of frontend features, driving design and implementation of scalable solutions in collaboration with cross-functional teams. Led development of key frontend modules, ensuring scalability and maintainability across the application
Designed and implemented reusable, component-driven UI architecture and shared libraries, improving scalability, consistency, and development efficiency across modules.
Implemented accessibility improvements in line with WCAG 2.2 guidelines, enhancing usability for keyboard and screen reader users.

Leveraged Generative AI tools (ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot) for code generation, debugging, refactoring, documentation, and development workflow optimization, improving engineering productivity and delivery efficiency.
Built and enhanced complex, data-intensive interfaces by integrating RESTful APIs, enabling real-time visibility and control for large-scale endpoint environments.
Optimized application performance through state management, render optimization, and lazy loading, improving responsiveness and handling high-volume data efficiently.
Contributed to system design discussions focusing on scalability, modular architecture, and maintainability in a cloud SaaS environment.
Engineered and maintained scalable web applications using React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML/CSS and modern UI frameworks including Material UI and Tailwind CSS.
Architected and implemented reusable, component-driven UI systems, improving code maintainability and reducing development effort by ~20%.
Integrated RESTful APIs to enable real-time, data-driven interfaces, improving data refresh efficiency and reducing manual reload dependency.
Developed a self-service platform that streamlined issue resolution, contributing to an estimated 20–30% reduction in support tickets.
Designed and delivered a centralized dashboard for navigation, monitoring, and reporting, improving operational visibility and reducing access time by ~25%.
Improved application performance through state management and render optimization, enhancing UI responsiveness by ~15–20%.
